name: Administrative Safeguards
description: Policies and procedures to manage the selection, development, and execution of security measures to protect ePHI, and to manage the workforce's conduct in relation to protecting that information.

name: Physical Safeguards
description: Physical measures, policies, and procedures to protect electronic information systems and related buildings and equipment from natural and environmental hazards and unauthorized intrusion.

name: Technical Safeguards
description: The technology and related policies and procedures that protect ePHI and control access to it.

name: Organizational Requirements
description: Requirements for contracts or other arrangements between a covered entity and its business associates, and related documentation.

name: Policies, Procedures & Documentation
description: Requirements to implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures, and to maintain documentation of actions, activities, and assessments.
